zh-CN.name: 保存状态反馈
zh-CN.description: 点击后显示处理中，完成后明确告知结果。本演示使用本地计时器，不会保存真实数据。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 演示保存按钮：点击后进入处理中并禁用重复提交，模拟 {feedback_delay_ms}ms 后展示完成状态，通过状态区域告知结果。真实产品等待服务端成功才显示保存完成。

en.name: Save Feedback
en.description: Show pending and completed states after input. This demo uses a local timer and does not save real data.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Demonstrate saving: show a pending state and prevent duplicate submission, then show completion after a simulated {feedback_delay_ms}ms. Announce the result in a status region. In production, show completion only after server confirmation.

sources.note: 原创概念说明与演示；参数为本项目示例，非标准值。
